overall: The AG found the Shutesbury Select Board violated the Open Meeting Law by not reviewing and releasing executive session minutes within 30 days or its next meeting after a request, and declined to review an insufficient-detail claim not raised in the original complaint.

allegations.summary: Board failed to review and release the May 13 and May 15 executive session minutes after the Nov. 3 request for them.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when it failed to review and release non-exempt executive session minutes within 30 days or the next meeting following the complainant's request.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the May 13 and May 15 executive session minutes were insufficiently detailed, raised first in the request for review.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review an allegation that was not included within the original complaint to the Board because the Board has not had an opportunity to respond to it.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
